notes: sheets.<sheet>.geometry is buildAtlasDrawGeometry(sheet, image) of the game (ART_DRAW_GEOMETRY), including the art-id aliases.
Cells are row-major: index = row * cols + col. Source rect of a geometry entry: (sx, sy, sourceW, sourceH); the sprite is drawn at (x + dxMul*w, y + dyMul*h) with size (dwMul*w, dhMul*h).
Images are drawn without smoothing. Runtime-derived images (hit-flash atlas, low-resolution caches, range ring tints) are not stored; runtime_derived holds their parameters for step S7.

runtime_derived.note: Images the game builds at run time with canvases. They are not stored; step S7 rebuilds them in shaders.

enemy_hit_flash.image: white silhouette of the sheet: a copy filled with #ffffff using source-in (alpha kept, RGB white)
enemy_hit_flash.applies_when: flash > 0 only: drawAtlasSprite wraps the pass in if(opts.flash){...}; drawEnemies passes artOpts.flash = e.flash; e.flash is set to 1 by a hit and decays by flash_decay_per_second down to 0
enemy_hit_flash.draw: only while flash > 0: drawn over the sprite with composite "lighter" at alpha = baseAlpha * (alpha_base + alpha_per_strength * s) with s = clamp(flash, 0, 1); when flash == 0 nothing is drawn
enemy_hit_flash.base_alpha_note: baseAlpha = opts.alpha == null ? 1 : opts.alpha; drawEnemies passes no alpha, so baseAlpha is always 1 for enemies
enemy_hit_flash.shader_equivalent: if flash > 0: rgb = min(rgb + k, 1) with k = baseAlpha * (0.32 + 0.46 * s), s = clamp(flash, 0, 1), baseAlpha = 1; if flash == 0: rgb unchanged (k = 0, NOT 0.32). k jumps from 0 to at least 0.32 as soon as flash > 0, so a shader must test flash > 0 before adding the 0.32 base. Exact up to 8-bit rounding because enemy alpha is binary

lowres_effect_cache.draw_size_in_drawSpriteFx: max(hits ? 1 : res, round(size / grid) * grid) with size = fx.size * (1 + fx.grow * progress) and grid = visualFxGrid(fx): 1 at ultra quality, otherwise REACTION_FX_GEOMETRY_GRID if fx.reactionFx, otherwise FX_GEOMETRY_GRID if fx.fxLowRes, otherwise 1 (spawnAtlasFx is the only producer of game.spriteFx and always sets fxLowRes: true)
lowres_effect_cache.position_snap_in_drawSpriteFx: the screen position x and y is snapped with visualFxSnap before drawing: round(v / grid) * grid when grid > 1, otherwise Math.round(v) (px)
lowres_effect_cache.sampling: nearest, both when scaling the cell down to res x res and when drawing it at the final size
lowres_effect_cache.measured_index_formula: source texel = cell_origin + ceil((i + 0.5) * cell_size / res) - 1 for destination pixel i. Measured in Chromium 141, not derived from the source, and valid only inside measured_index_formula_scope (floor((i + 0.5) * cell_size / res) is wrong on 7-26 percent of the pixels)
lowres_effect_cache.measured_index_formula_scope: exact (0 mismatches) for 32 px cells (effects, hits, enemies) and 64 px cells (characters) at every res from 6 to 72, and for the 256 px range cells at res 32, 64, 96 and 128. NOT a general rule (Skia steps in fixed point): it fails for some 256 px cell resolutions, for example res 28, 30, 52, 56, 60, 104, 112, 120, 126 and 190 (122 of 50176 pixels at res 112). Every resolution the game uses is inside the scope; re-measure in Chromium if RANGE_FX_CACHE_RESOLUTION, FX_RASTER_RES, REACTION_FX_RASTER_RES or a cell size changes

range_fx_tint.cell_downscale: the 256 px style cell is scaled down to raster.<mode>.RANGE_FX_CACHE_RESOLUTION (96 coarse, 128 fine; both inside the verified measured_index_formula_scope of lowres_effect_cache, which is not valid for every resolution) with the index formula of lowres_effect_cache
range_fx_tint.alpha_rule: a < alpha_cut -> 0, otherwise min(255, round(a / alpha_step) * alpha_step)
range_fx_tint.order: ring mask (destination-in, anti-aliased), tint colour (source-in), alpha quantisation
